StepDescription: Launch Lorenzo Application
Login with valid credentials
Wait for home page to load
Navigate to Patients tab
Wait for Patients tab to load
Generate random surname for new patient
Enter random surname in patient search
Click Find to search for patient
Wait for patient search results
Click Book Registration link to open registration form
Wait for patient registration form to load
Enter patient Forename
Enter patient Surname (random value)
Enter Postal Code
Click Find to resolve address from postal code
Wait for address lookup results
Select address row from lookup results
Enter City
Select Country
Enter Home Telephone number
Enter Mobile Telephone number
Enter Email address
Click Next to proceed to demographics section
Wait for demographics section to load
Select Communication Preference Type
Select Country of Birth
Select Nationality
Select Religion
Select Sexual Orientation
Select Ethnicity
Click Finish to complete patient registration
Wait for registration confirmation popup
Capture and store NHS Number allocated to patient
Verify NHS Number is not empty in confirmation
Click OK to dismiss registration confirmation popup
Wait for home page after registration
Click Find Record to search for registered patient
Wait for patient basic search form
Enter random surname to find registered patient
Click Find to search for patient
Wait for patient search results
Click patient surname link to open EPR
Wait for EPR view to load
Verify EPR loaded - PASID field is visible
Store PAS ID from EPR for later reference
-- CREATE REFERRAL --
Click Referrals tab to navigate to referral section
Wait for Referrals tab to load
Click Create Referral link
Wait for Create Referral form to load
Select Service Type for the referral
Select Referral Source
Select Referral Priority
Select Referral Type
Click Finish Now to submit the referral
Wait for referral creation to complete
Verify referral row is displayed in referral list
-- ADMIT PATIENT --
Select referral row in list to initiate admission
Click Inpatient option from context menu to initiate admission
Wait for Admission road map page to load
Select Admission Source
Select Admission Type
Select Intended Management
Select Ward Name for admission
Click Next to proceed to admission confirmation
Wait for admission confirmation page
Click Finish to complete patient admission
Wait for EPR to load after admission
Verify EPR loaded successfully after admission
-- NAVIGATE TO RESULTS REQUESTS EPR VIEW --
Click Results Requests EPR tab to navigate to R&R section
Wait for Results Requests EPR tab to load
Verify Results Requests EPR tab is active
-- PLACE REQUEST --
Click Place request link from Results Requests context pane
Wait for Place Request form to load
Enter Request Type in powersearch
Click Search button to find request type
Wait for search results to load
Enter Request Priority
Click Finish Now to submit the place request
Wait for request list view to load
Verify Request Status column is displayed - request Placed successfully
-- MODIFY REQUEST --
Select the Placed request row
Wait for context pane to update
Click Modify request link from context pane
Wait for Modify Request form to load
Select Reason for Request
Select Modification Reason
Click Apply to save modifications
Wait for Apply to process
Click Finish to complete modification
Wait for request list view to reload
Verify Request Status is updated after modification
-- SUSPEND REQUEST --
Select the Placed request row to suspend
Wait for context pane to update
Click Suspend request link from context pane
Wait for Suspend Request form to load
Select Suspension Reason
Click Apply to apply suspension
Wait for Apply to process
Click Finish to complete suspension
Wait for request list view to reload
Verify Request Status is updated to Suspended
-- RE-INSTATE REQUEST --
Select the Suspended request row to re-instate
Wait for context pane to update
Click Re-instate request link from context pane
Wait for Re-instate Request form to load
Select Re-instate Reason
Click Apply to apply re-instatement
Wait for Apply to process
Click Finish to complete re-instatement
Wait for request list view to reload
Verify Request Status is updated to Placed after re-instatement
-- REPEAT REQUEST --
Click Repeat request link from Results Requests context pane
Wait for Repeat Request form to load
Enter Request Type in powersearch for repeat
Click Search button to find request type for repeat
Wait for search results to load
Enter Request Priority for repeat
Click Finish Now to submit the repeat request
Wait for request list view to reload
Verify new Request Status is Placed after repeat request
-- CANCEL REQUEST --
Select the Placed request row to cancel
Wait for context pane to update
Click Cancel request link from context pane
Wait for Cancel Request form to load
Select Cancellation Reason
Click Apply to apply cancellation
Wait for Apply to process
Click Finish to complete cancellation
Wait for request list view to reload
Verify Request Status is updated to Cancelled
-- ENTER RESULT --
Click Enter result link from Results Requests context pane
Wait for Enter Result form to load
Enter Request Type in powersearch for result entry
Click Search button to find the request
Wait for search results to load
Enter Result Value
Enter Sample/Performed Date
Click Apply to save result entry
Wait for Apply to process
Click Finish to complete result entry
Wait for request list view to reload
Verify result entry saved - request status updated to Performed
-- MODIFY RESULTS --
Select the Performed request row to modify results
Wait for context pane to update
Click Modify results link from context pane
Wait for Modify Results form to load
Enter updated Result Value
Select Modification Reason for result change
Click Apply to save modified result
Wait for Apply to process
Click Finish to complete result modification
Wait for request list view to reload
Verify result modification is saved and request status updated
-- AUTHORISE RESULTS --
Select the Performed request row to authorise results
Wait for context pane to update
Click Authorise results link from context pane
Wait for Authorise Results form to load
Click Apply to authorise the results
Wait for Apply to process
Click Finish to complete authorisation
Wait for request list view to reload
Verify Result workflow status is updated to Pending Acknowledgement
-- ACKNOWLEDGE RESULTS --
Select the Pending Acknowledgement request row
Wait for context pane to update
Click Acknowledge results link from context pane
Wait for Acknowledge Results form to load
Click Apply to acknowledge the results
Wait for Apply to process
Click Finish to complete acknowledgement
Wait for request list view to reload
Verify Result workflow status is updated to Acknowledged
-- LOGOUT --
Click Logout button
Confirm logout by clicking Yes
Wait for login page to load after logout
